name: How do I choose the right contractor for a whole-home remodel?

mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right contractor for a whole-home remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Choosing the right contractor involves evaluating their experience, communication style, and track record. Look for a licensed and insured general contractor specializing in whole-home remodels, like Simply Construction, with a portfolio of relevant projects. Check references, read reviews, and ensure they provide transparent, detailed proposals. A good contractor will also help manage the permitting process and maintain clear communication throughout the project duration.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a contractor based on experience, licensing, insurance, portfolio, and transparent communication. Check references and ensure they handle permitting.
